# Original M49 pages and citation guidance

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**


These two HTML files are the retained geographic-classification sources. Deduplication removed identical copies, not the originals. Exclusion from GitHub language statistics does not mean the sources are absent.

- United Nations Statistics Division, *Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49)*; accessed 26 October 2026. Local [m49_page.html](m49_page.html) includes the FAQ.
- UNSD, *M49 overview table (countries or areas)*; same recorded access date. Local [m49_overview.html](m49_overview.html) supports codes and parent hierarchy.

The original URLs and access dates are in [sources.csv](sources.csv). Do not turn the access year into an unverified publication year or claim a new download occurred during deduplication.

The study uses M49 as a statistical geographic framework, with separately documented conventions for historical teams and representative associations. M49 does not decide sovereignty, FIFA membership or rating continuity. Applying a fixed framework to 1980–2024 is a project decision, not a UN-provided official history of every team.

[relocations.json](relocations.json) maps 18 old paths to the shared originals. Historical manifests are not rewritten. Use the artifact resolver or read these files directly. The [Q3 guide](../../../../研究/03_地域差异/README.en.md) explains carrier assumptions, and the [source review](../../../../outputs/logs/regions/design-review-20261026/review.json) separates formal evidence from failed responses and caches.

Original preserved file: [README.md](README.md). This reading edition does not replace its registered evidence.
